newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends weaker, fails to close gap.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends weaker, fails to close gap.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed a thinly-traded session slightly lower after the March contract tried and failed to close a gap on the charts between 10.47 and 10.50 cents, market sources said.
"The fact that the market failed (to close the gap) after being so close is bearish technically," a broker said.
However, prices are likely to trade point-for-point on the way down due to mixed buying below the market, he added.
The March contract closed 0.03 lower at 10.41, traded 10.46 to 10.39 cents. The back months finished unchanged to 0.02 lower, on volume estimated at 11,764 lots.
Producer selling beginning at 10.50 cents capped gains and overpowered the buying that emerged early.
"The market only has limited strength from the speculators," a dealer said.
The trade was also noted as a strong buyer in the March/May spread.
